scope: Complete private checkout through existing browser-owned Switch/progress, and cancellable atomic initial metadata publication. Full port remains incomplete.

verification.native_route: Expanded shipping-controller receiver passes Apple and bundled Git. Real checkout of an older branch changes HEAD and tracked file despite later draft revision/force edits. All three progress-close policies, successful progress acknowledgement/parent/close/Quit locks, single change/ack and duplicate completion checked. Pull post-action dispatch captured with previous branch; no Pull operation/network performed. Browser retains cached current branch as source Switch case does; Current Branch accepts live changed branch afterward. Rejected shipping-controller progress presentation releases its unstarted result without checkout.
verification.metadata_lifecycle: Both actual initial Git reads (for-each-ref and branch --show-current) independently paused by private wrapper/helper after parent browser load. Receiver observes both recorded PIDs live and unpublished child catalog, forces browser close, verifies both processes exit, and rejects late references/fields/error. Metadata cancellation and App Store scope check share a request; both values publish after completion.
verification.route_regression: Existing source commit-object/bare gates, original menu icon, canonical local/remote/symbolic HEAD/light-tag/notes and packed NFC/NFD native presets/defaults, parent/competing/cancel/reject/forced nested picker locks and unchanged original open/cancel fixture still pass both engines.
verification.progress_regression: Existing Switch progress receiver passes both engines: real remote tracking, detach, force/override, captured options, cross-name conflict capture, failed retry, all close policies, .gitmodules/once post actions, owned cancellation/fresh retry, deferred completion, missing presentation and hidden close/Quit.
verification.picker_regression: Existing Switch full reference/Log picker receiver passes both engines: native fields/focus, canonical byte-distinct refs, role/default/draft retention, F5 fresh catalog, typed revision history graph, ownership/cancel/stale/reject/closed gates.
verification.core: Eight CheckoutTests pass with both Git engines.
verification.cycles: Zero AttributeGraph cycle warnings in all three final native logs.
verification.debug: Unsigned Debug build and standalone bundle audit pass.
verification.inventory: Pin checker passes; mappings remain partial.
verification.site: Local Pages rebuild passes; no deployment or updated screenshots.
verification.ci: Existing workflow invokes expanded script; hosted CI status/execution unverified.
verification.store: Unsigned AppStore build and required standalone bundle audit pass: universal bundled Git 2.55.0, LFS 3.8.0, EditorConfig and IssueRegex runtimes, embedded Finder extension, license notices and all 99 upstream icons. Signed execution/App Store acceptance unverified.
verification.notice: Both packaged NOTICE files byte-equal source.

limitations: Physical sheets, focus restoration, actual mouse/keyboard/IME, light/dark/accessibility and signed security scope behavior remain unverified.
Forced close during checkout validation or active checkout/progress, external ref/HEAD races and other shared chooser consumers lifecycle need broader checks.
Receiver captures configured post-action callback; it does not instantiate RepositoryModel or perform Pull/network.
Signed Finder integration/App Store acceptance, remaining source commands/dialogs and whole app port remain incomplete. No main app launches, push or deployment.
